name: Sticker Maker
summary: Die-cut sticker designs with a white border, exported as transparent PNGs.

seo.title: AI Sticker Maker – Die-Cut Designs as Transparent PNG
seo.description: Describe a sticker idea and get a die-cut design with a white border on a transparent background. Download print-ready PNGs for Cricut, Etsy or print shops.
intro: Describe what you want on the sticker and pick a style. PiCraft draws it with a clean white die-cut border and removes the background, so you get a transparent PNG ready for cutting.
Use it with Cricut Print Then Cut, sell on Etsy or Redbubble, or send it to any sticker printer.

faq.a: Yes. In Design Space, upload the PNG, save it as a Print Then Cut image, print it on printable sticker paper and let the machine cut around the white border. Check the cut preview before you start, and finish printing and cutting in one session.
You can use designs you generate commercially. Avoid descriptions that copy trademarked characters, logos or other people's artwork.
2–3 inch stickers are the most common. The 3×3 in file is ready at 300 DPI; scale down in your print software for smaller sizes.

faq.q: Do I need to remove the background myself?
faq.a: No. PiCraft removes the background for you and exports a PNG that is transparent outside the white border. If you notice a grey fringe or a missing edge, generate the sticker again.

faq.q: Can I print a sheet of different stickers?
faq.a: Each generation is one design. Place several PNGs on one page in your print software or in Cricut Design Space, then print the sheet on sticker paper.

faq.q: How do I keep a sticker pack looking consistent?
faq.a: Use the same style for every design and describe each subject in a similar way. Styles are consistent but not identical between generations, so pick the best result of each.

faq.q: What paper or vinyl should I use?
faq.a: Printable sticker paper works with most inkjet printers. For stickers that will be handled, washed or left outdoors, use printable vinyl and add a clear laminate or overlay.

faq.q: Can I add more than a few words of text?
faq.a: Text is limited to 30 characters. Short phrases of one to four words come out best, and you should always proofread them before printing.

faq.q: Is the white border part of the file?
faq.a: Yes. The white border is drawn into the design and the transparent edge sits just outside it, so a machine or printer cutting along that edge leaves a clean white margin.
